description: Example MonitoringCtrlr instance for a secondary OCPP connection, as described in the OCA application note 'Secondary OCPP Connection on a Charging Station' section 5.5. Needed only if the connection is to install monitors of its own or subscribe to somebody else's; without it the connection's monitors report to the CSMS instead. The instance name must match the OCPPCommCtrlr instance that declares the connection.
name: MonitoringCtrlr

SubscribedMonitors.description: Comma separated list of the monitor ids whose NotifyEvents this connection wants to be sent. The charging station adds a monitor here when this connection installs it and removes it when it is cleared. Empty to begin with: a new connection is subscribed to nothing.
